content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge is resolving a link against [DR3]'s pressed sign-bound verses by treating the sign's own wording as decisive, so K-C governs how that chain collision must be weighed.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the sign itself does not state the mechanism.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"the phrase 'never verse by verse': I weighed whether the judge's use of 'the sign itself does not state the mechanism' is a prohibited single-verse stating-verse test or merely a chain-support observation; it is the former because the sign's own silence is made decisive.","why":"The judge declares the link underdetermined because Isaiah 7:14 itself does not state the mechanism, which is a verse-level stating-verse test rather than chain-against-chain weighing by footing."}
